### Message

```text
Completed and published in **[draft PR #1](https://github.com/Andres-ArangoMartinez/DS675_MiniProject/pull/1)**. It has not been merged.

### Files changed

28 files, including:

- [Prompt audit](<D:/GitHub/ML NJIT/MiniProject/DS675_MiniProject/docs/PROMPT_VERIFICATION_AUDIT.md>).
- [Corrected prompt V2.1](<D:/GitHub/ML NJIT/MiniProject/DS675_MiniProject/provenance/engineering_prompt/v2_1_verified_instructions.json>).
- [Feedback response matrix](<D:/GitHub/ML NJIT/MiniProject/DS675_MiniProject/docs/FEEDBACK_RESPONSE_MATRIX.md>).
- Literature comparisons, engineering rationale, experimental plan and verification scripts.

The original prompt and historical report remain preserved.

### Professor-feedback items addressed

Added traceable evidence and explicit attribution. Important corrections:

- Area A has more **pressure sensors**, not more measurement channels overall.
- n1 is highest among the three monitored C nodes, but ranks **24th among its 92 junctions**.
- Nominal and generator elevations agree; pipe distances and tank diameters differ.
- 2019 cannot be described as untouched.

Ahmed’s methods/results were checked against the paper. Full-text inspection also confirmed daily overlays and average curves in **Figure 4, page 5**, of the [prior ASCE article](https://doi.org/10.1061/JWRMD5.WRENG-7321).

### Evidence and tests actually verified

- **5 tests passed**.
- **138 local links checked**, none broken.
- Complete descriptive reproduction passed; six numerical output files matched exactly.
- Historical hashes and geometry manifests checked.
- **[New GitHub Actions run passed](https://github.com/Andres-ArangoMartinez/DS675_MiniProject/actions/runs/40697368968)**.

### Research contribution and key hypotheses
